results.excerpt: Rate limit incident Q3 2024: API consumers were not warned 24 hours before the rate limit threshold was lowered from 1000 to 500 requests per minute. Several clients experienced outages lasting 2-4 hours.
Lessons learned: (1) All limit changes require 72-hour advance notice. (2) Clients must have a documented escalation path. (3) Rate limit headers should be included in all API responses.
API versioning policy: breaking changes require a deprecation notice period of at least 30 days. Rate limit adjustments are considered breaking changes when they reduce the existing limit.

output_document.summary: The project decision record has been updated to reflect critical changes to the API validation rule based on lessons learned from the Q3 2024 rate limit incident. Key changes include: (1) mandatory 72-hour advance notice for all limit changes, (2) documented escalation paths for affected clients, (3) rate limit headers required in all API responses, and (4) formal classification of rate limit adjustments as breaking changes requiring 30-day deprecation notice. These measures prevent future outages by ensuring proper consumer notification and transparent API behavior.
